additional_info.subject: ID0477191-DC/Si-D/SE-{MP/S3 170003435} Main circuit Breaker actuated CRM:02889001075 [21010]
additional_info.body:
Hi Andreas, good afternoon. I hope you are doing well.
We are suspecting either one of two scenarios:
Interference of any kind in the busbar of DC4, e.g, a loose cable touching the busbar or dirt/snow/water.
Bender is faulty
In this case, to prove that the fault is not on the bender my recommendation is to swap BC3 and BC4, and if the problem persists in the BC4 (now in BC3 place), then we should replace it.
When swapping the Benders, you need to change their address as well, which you can do manually on it's screen here:
You need to change the address of the BC4 from 6 to 5 and the BC3 from 5 to 6.
If you need more help, please reach out to Magnus, he will ask for my support if needed.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
